request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Caltrop Slinger".

Creative brief
Name: Caltrop Slinger
Collection: Ironroad Marauders. Organized highway raiders who turn practical medieval weapons, shields, traps, chains, and stolen supplies into disciplined projectile patterns.
Core concept: A trap specialist that creates temporary zones rather than direct damage pressure.
Body and silhouette: Lean hooded raider with a shoulder bag, leather sling, and low crouched stance.
Signature features: Caltrop-filled satchel, wrapped forearms, and triangular metal ammunition.
Palette and materials: Dark brown, muted mustard, worn gray steel, and faded blue cloth.
Movement personality: Sneaky, calculating, and constantly retreating.
Attack concept: Slings a large caltrop bundle to a marked spot where it breaks into four stationary hazards arranged in a cross.
Directional details: The ammunition satchel hangs on the left hip.
Avoid: Magical floating mines, modern explosives, hazards too small to notice.
